raw_segments.text: Erula, woo, they may have dropped him already being tired of carrying him, who can trust
the bandar log, put dead bats on my head, give me black bones to eat, roll me into the
hives of the wild bees that I may be stung to death and bury me with the hyena, for I
Erolala, wahua, oh Mowgli, Mowgli, why did I not warn thee against the monkey folk instead
Now perhaps I may have knocked the day's lesson out of his mind, and he will be alone
in the jungle without the master words.
